entries.en: to stop (someone) from scolding; to forbid an insult
entries.notes: 汉字对音「阻罵」清晰，但西语头 a„ergoncar en malo pa la coßig 排印残损、语义不明，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 失人；在人前丢脸、失体面
entries.en: to lose face; to fall into disgrace before others

entries.zh: 阻人无理妄为；拦阻人不要任意行事
entries.en: to prevent someone from doing what he wants (wrongly)
entries.notes: 汉字「阻人無意使」四字可读作拦阻他人之意，西语头 a„ergoncar, otro… 排印残损且语义牵强，存疑降中置信。

entries.zh: 羞愧难当、张口无言；甚为羞惭
entries.en: to be deeply ashamed; ashamed to the point of being unable to speak
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注「欺甚 [疑:歁甚]」，字目有异文存疑；西语头 de ne cinir 亦残损，故降中置信。

entries.zh: 当众出丑；在人前羞辱（他）
entries.en: to shame him before the crowd
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注「翕衆 [疑:歙衆]」异文存疑，仅依西语 a„ergoncarle delante de otros 与音写推断。

entries.en: shame; I am greatly ashamed
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注「羞 [疑:盖]」，且有「tengo muy fuanda」一句残文（疑为 muy huida / 極羞 之类抄写讹误），语义不完全可定。

entries.en: to blush; to feel shame on one's face
shame; to feel shame
to feel ashamed; shame and remorse
humiliation; to suffer disgrace

entries.zh: 失体面；竟至无羞耻之心（引西语 ja vergonça）
entries.en: to lose one's shame; without shame (as the appended Spanish gloss 'ja vergonça' indicates)
entries.notes: 汉字「失接」字面难解，条内附写 ja vergonça（已/既 羞）提示语义为「已失羞耻」，属推断，降中置信。

entries.en: to stain and disgrace; to bring dishonor upon

entries.zh: 摆妒；因妒而生羞（字目存疑）
entries.en: jealous shame (character reading uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「八妬 [疑:姖]」字目两处存疑，与 a„ergoncar 的语义关联不明，按残缺处理。

entries.en: to be ashamed of what is base; to shrink from contemptible things
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注「偎鄙 [疑:畏鄙]」，取「畏鄙」义与西语 por leuitar（疑为 levtar/levitación 类残文）互证仍不足，中置信。

entries.en: to find out; to inquire into
entries.notes: 西语头连排 averiguar/fuigar/examinar/preguntar 义为「查明」，与汉字「豁」对应属推断；对音 R「cō hēo」与汉字单字不完全相合，降中置信。

entries.en: to ascertain and decide; to settle a matter by investigation
to interrogate; to examine (a case)
to interrogate and scrutinize; to examine thoroughly
to investigate; to get to the bottom of

entries.zh: 究竟；彻底查明（附注：为求脱免）
entries.en: to scrutinize to the very end; to examine thoroughly (appended gloss: in order to escape)
entries.notes: 条内附写 por fuigīr 语义（为逃避而穷究）依西语 perspicimar 与汉字「究竟」推断，非全然可定，中置信。

entries.en: to judge; to adjudicate (Spanish 'judgando')
to interrogate closely; to cross-question
to inquire about a matter; to question (Spanish 'preguntando')
to inspect; to examine on visitation

entries.zh: 勘问；如教士巡视时按查询问
entries.en: to interrogate by inquiry; to examine as in an official visitation
entries.notes: 西语头 como el pregado en la uisita 中 pregado 疑为 prebendado/教职人员 之讹，属推断，中置信。
